Name: SecondWind
Description: A sudden, unearned burst of not-dying. Sponsors love this one - it's cheap and it always plays well.

Name: SteadyHands
Description: For a while, nothing shakes. Deeply suspicious for someone who fell down a hole this morning.

Name: MinorFortitude
Description: A little sturdier than you have any right to be. The audience is told this is 'grit.'

Name: SilverTongue
Description: Everything you say for the next while sounds like it was written by someone who gets paid to write things.

Name: AdrenalineSurge
Description: The building already fell on you once today. This is your body deciding that was rehearsal.

Name: IronWill
Description: A real, load-bearing toughness, on loan. Return policy unclear.

Name: ClarityOfPurpose
Description: Every decision for a while feels correct in advance. This has never once been true before now.

Name: SponsorsBlessing
Description: Someone with real money is now, briefly, personally invested in you surviving. Enjoy it - it will not renew itself.

Name: ComplimentaryRefill
Description: The System tops you up, the way a waiter tops up a glass you did not ask to have topped up.

Name: SponsoredHydration
Description: This moment of not being thirsty is brought to you by a water brand with a mountain on it. Not this mountain.

Name: ViralMoment
Description: Somebody clipped that. Somebody is setting it to music. For five minutes, everyone likes you.

Name: PerformanceEnhancerLegal
Description: Approved by a board that met once, in a parking lot. You feel great. Do not read the label.

Name: SecondOpinion
Description: The System has consulted a second System. They agree you should be smarter, briefly.

Name: CaffeineDrip
Description: Every bean in the break room, administered at once. Your hands are very fast and you can hear colours.

Name: ExtendedWarranty
Description: Covers you for another six hundred seconds of ordinary wear and tear. Acts of monster are excluded.

Name: StandingOvation
Description: The audience is on its feet. The applause physically heals you. Nobody can explain this and nobody is trying.

Name: PlotArmor
Description: The writers have decided you are not dying in this episode. They reserve the right to revisit that.

Name: DirectorsCut
Description: Every scene you are in is now longer, faster and better lit.

Name: AudienceFavorite
Description: They chant your name. They spell it wrong. It works anyway.

Name: DivineIntervention
Description: Something enormous reaches down and fixes you, then leaves a business card.
